The Actions job metadata does not expose the underlying stderr/request URL; the probe has therefore been changed so provider/host exceptions are captured into production telemetry instead of aborting the workflow.

Probe auctions.savills.co.uk, www.savills.co.uk and savills.co.uk so pre-dedicated-subdomain Savills UK auction URLs can be discovered.
